Before You Place Your Order - A Quick Check ✖

To ensure a smooth delivery and perfect fit, please confirm the following:

  • Product fit & feel: Have you visited a Duroflex Experience Centre to check the sofa’s dimensions, colour, and comfort?
  • Entry access: If you live in a villa, is your main door at least 900 mm wide for easy movement of the sofa?
  • Staircase access (for villas): If the sofa needs to be moved to the 2nd or 3rd floor, are the stairs 800-1000 mm wide?
  • Lift access (for apartments): Is a service lift available for sofa movement?
  • Service lift dimensions: Does the service lift have a minimum door width of 900 mm and height of at least 2100 mm?
  • Stair carry (if no service lift): If there’s no service lift, please mention the number of floors the sofa will need to be carried up via stairs in your address details.

Tailored Ergonomics

3-Zone Padding provides graduated support for your neck, back, and lumbar region.Pocket Spring Technology layered beneath plush foam in the seat offers extra bounce and plushness—giving you that just-right cushioned feel without sagging over time. Crafted for long hours of use, the recliner includes breathable padding zones that allow for airflow while keeping your body supported. Comfortable arm support eases pressure on your shoulders. A footrest extension relaxes your calves and leg muscles while promoting better circulation. Duroflex foam cushioning ensures long-lasting softness and structure, so the comfort never fades.

Why choose Posture Pro?

India’s most trusted mattress brand, now brings its expertise to your living room.High quality, high resilience, a little extra bounciness for that luxurious sink-in comfort.Diligent performance testing to meet international durability industry standards.

Crafted with a premium materials, this recliner is designed for durability and lasting comfort. 3-Zone Padding provides graduated support for your neck, back, and lumbar region. The headrest uses soft homogenized fiber to relieve neck pressure, The mid-back features medium-density poly fiber for balanced support, while the seat area uses high-density fiber to cradle your lower back and hips with firmness where it matters.

Frequently asked Questions

1. What is the Avalon Posture Pro Recliner?

The Avalon Posture Pro is a motorized, rocking and rotating recliner designed for long hours of use. The ergonomic design relieves neck pressure, relaxes leg muscles, and provides back support. Built with 3-zone padding and pocket springs, it provides a luxurious seating experience.

2. What are the unique features of the Avalon Posture Pro Recliner?

The Avalon Posture Pro is designed with 3-zone ergonomic padding that supports your neck, back, and lumbar region for better posture. It features pocket spring seating layered with plush Duroflex foam for enhanced comfort and bounce, along with breathable padding zones that improve airflow during extended use. The recliner also includes rocking and 360° rotating functionality, comfortable arm support, and a footrest extension to relax your legs. Built using premium materials and compliant with international durability standards, it ensures long-lasting performance.

3. How much weight can the Avalon Posture Pro Recliner support?

The Avalon Posture Pro Recliner is designed for sturdy everyday use and can comfortably support approximately 120 kg under normal residential conditions.

4. How does the motorized reclining mechanism work?

The recliner features an effortless powered control system that allows you to adjust the backrest and footrest smoothly using a simple switch. With precise control, you can recline, pause, or reset the position to match your comfort preference.

5. Does the motorized recliner need to be plugged in constantly or does it have a battery?

The recliner operates when connected to a power source, ensuring smooth and consistent motorised performance. It does not rely on a standalone battery for regular use.

6. What reclining positions and angles can the recliner achieve?

The Avalon Posture Pro Recliner offers multiple reclining positions, allowing you to move from an upright seating posture to a deeply relaxed lounging position. It reclines up to approximately 150°, enabling flexible comfort for reading, watching TV, or resting.

7. Is professional installation or assembly included with the Avalon Posture Pro Recliner?

Yes. Basic installation assistance is provided during delivery to ensure the recliner is set up correctly and ready for use.

8. What are the space requirements for the Avalon Posture Pro Recliner?

Ensure sufficient space not only for placement but also for full recline, rocking, and rotation movement. Additionally, check that doorways, lifts, and passageways allow smooth delivery and installation.

9. What warranty comes with the Avalon Posture Pro Recliner?

The Avalon Posture Pro Recliner comes with a 1-year warranty covering manufacturing defects under normal residential use.

10. Can I try the Avalon Posture Pro Recliner before purchasing?

Yes. You can experience the recliner at select Duroflex retail stores. Assisted shopping options such as virtual consultations are also available.

11. Is the Avalon Posture Pro Recliner customizable (fabric, colour, configuration)?

The recliner is available in select colour options and comes as a single-seater configuration. Customization options are currently not available.

12. Is the Avalon Posture Pro available in different color choices?

The Avalon Posture pro comes in four different color options; Brown, Beige, Tan & Grey.

13. What seating configurations are available for the Avalon Posture Pro Recliner?

The Avalon Posture Pro is offered as a single-seater recliner, designed for individual comfort with advanced ergonomic support.

14. How do I clean and maintain the Avalon Posture Pro Recliner?

Vacuum the fabric regularly using a soft brush attachment to remove dust. Avoid exposure to moisture and direct sunlight. In case of spills, clean gently using a suitable fabric cleaner. Periodic professional cleaning is recommended to maintain comfort and fabric quality over time.
